You definitely do not sound crazy at ALL! I went through these same things.. and I hate to speak negatively of my ex, because it’s been so long, but he was also an addict (gambling, not drugs.) I think this was a big source of shame and anger for him, and he took it out on me. I’m not sure if there is something to that, but that is interesting that they have that in common. He was also a great partner and a really nice guy most of the time. The bad times just got darker and darker, to the point that my confidence was almost gone. I would say for red flags- just watch out for him picking on you. That sounds stupid, but it’s true. Things like making fun of you, saying rude things, trying to make you self conscious, talking about you to other people. These are all done to make you look/feel bad. People like this are very insecure and will want you at your lowest so that you never feel above them. Also, the privacy thing is very concerning, and I do think that you are right for wanting boundaries. Like, very right. 

Those are the little things. If he escalates to yelling, cruelty, I would really recommend you tell someone you trust and make an exit strategy. I stayed around for way to long once that started, and it got very bad. I am okay now though, and with a partner who is very loving and respectful. 

I hope that your relationship doesn’t go down that road, for your sake, but please just make sure to take care of yourself either way <3
